careers.name: Actuary and quantitative risk analyst
careers.about: Prices life and non-life insurance policies, calculates reserves, models pension liabilities and evaluates financial risk for insurers, banks and regulators.

careers.name: Audiologist and speech-language therapist
careers.about: Diagnoses and treats hearing loss, balance disorders, stammering, delayed speech in children and post-stroke swallowing or speech difficulties.

careers.name: Registered midwife and maternal health specialist
careers.about: Leads antenatal care, safe normal deliveries, newborn resuscitation and maternal health programmes in hospitals, birthing centres and rural municipalities.

careers.name: Clinical perfusionist and anaesthesia technologist
careers.about: Operates heart-lung bypass machines during cardiac surgery or manages anaesthesia workstations, ventilators and ICU monitoring alongside surgical teams.

careers.name: Economist and policy researcher
careers.about: Analyses inflation, trade, budgets, poverty and development programmes for Nepal Rastra Bank, ministries, think tanks, banks and international agencies.

careers.name: Psychologist and mental health counsellor
careers.about: Provides psychological assessment, psychotherapy and psychosocial counselling in hospitals, schools, NGOs and private mental health practices.

careers.name: Fashion, textile and interior designer
careers.about: Designs garments,boutique collections, retail spaces, homes and commercial interiors for studios, export houses, hospitality brands and independent labels.

careers.name: Mountaineering, expedition and adventure leader
careers.about: Plans and leads high-altitude expeditions, trekking, alpine rescue and adventure tourism operations certified under Nepal Mountain Academy and NMA standards.

routes.name: Open and Alternative Secondary School (CEHRD SEE)
routes.entry: Class 8 passed or age/bridge requirements set by CEHRD for out-of-school learners
routes.about: Government-recognised open and flexible schooling run through designated public schools for working youth, homemakers and students returning after a study gap. Learners sit the exact same NEB SEE board examination and earn an identical certificate.
routes.exam: SEE (Secondary Education Examination)

routes.name: Sports Academy or Sainik / Police Residential School (Class 9 to 12)
routes.entry: Passed Class 8, physical fitness trial and written entrance test
routes.about: Combines regular NEB Class 9 to 12 academics with structured athletics at National Sports Council / ANFA academies or disciplined residential schooling at Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya, Nepal Police School and APF School.
routes.exam: Selection trials, SEE and NEB Class 12 board exams

routes.name: PCL in Medical Laboratory Technology (CMLT, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year clinical laboratory diploma training Level 5 Lab Technicians in haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, parasitology and blood banking. CTEVT constituent schools charge around NPR 52k (subsidised) to 1.33 lakh, while private colleges cap around NPR 3.98 lakh. Requires NHPC licence.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then NHPC licensing exam

routes.name: PCL in Diagnostic Radiography (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Trains Level 5 Radiographers to perform digital X-ray, fluoroscopy, ultrasound support and CT imaging in hospitals. CTEVT constituent SOHS Bharatpur charges NPR 52k (subsidised) to 3.28 lakh (full pay), and graduates register with the NHPC.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then NHPC licensing exam

routes.name: PCL in Ophthalmic Science (Ophthalmic Assistant, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Run by CTEVT in partnership with Tilganga and Nepal Netra Jyoti Sangh eye hospitals. Trains Level 5 Ophthalmic Assistants to test vision, prescribe glasses, assist in cataract surgery and run community eye-care centres across Nepal.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then NHPC licensing exam

routes.name: PCL in Dental Science (Dental Hygiene, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year CTEVT dental hygiene programme training Level 5 Dental Hygienists in ultrasonic scaling, atraumatic restorative treatment, dental radiography, local anaesthesia and oral health outreach.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then NHPC licensing exam

routes.name: PCL in Ayurveda (AHA) or Physiotherapy (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year CTEVT diplomas training Ayurveda Health Assistants (who run municipal Ayurveda dispensaries and Panchakarma units) or Physiotherapy Assistants (who support rehabilitation clinics and hospitals).
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then Ayurveda Medical Council or NHPC registration

routes.name: Diploma in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical or Architecture (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with required grades in Maths and Science
routes.about: Practical 3-year engineering diplomas taught at public polytechnics (Balaju, Manmohan Polytechnic, KNIT Butwal, Bheri Technical School). Graduates qualify for Sub-Engineer (Level 5) posts in NEA, road/hydropower projects and industry, or lateral BE entry.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance and semester board exams

routes.name: BMathSc (Actuarial Science) and Bachelor in Data Science (TU SMS)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream with at least 100 marks in Mathematics and D+ / 1.8 CGPA
routes.about: Taught at Tribhuvan University School of Mathematical Sciences (Balkhu). Blends mathematics, probability, statistics, finance and computer science to train Nepal's own actuaries and data scientists for life/non-life insurance companies, banks and analytics firms.
routes.exam: TU IOST School of Mathematical Sciences written entrance and interview

routes.name: BASLP (Bachelor of Audiology and Speech Language Pathology)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) with at least 50% or 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Clinical degree at TU IOM Maharajgunj and MBAHS Hetauda training specialists in hearing assessment, hearing aids, cochlear implants and speech-language therapy. MEC fixes the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh, with scholarship seats via MECEE-BL.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BMid / BSc Midwifery Sciences
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) or PCL Nursing with NNC licence as per MEC rules (50% / 2.4 CGPA)
routes.about: Prepares autonomous professional midwives to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality in referral hospitals and rural birthing centres. MEC fixes the 4-year paying tuition cap at NPR 10.36 lakh, with 75% public scholarship seats at NAMS, KU, PAHS, RAHS and KAHS.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BPerfusionTech / BSc Anaesthesia / Critical Care Technology
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) or relevant health diploma with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: High-demand operation-theatre and ICU allied health degrees: Perfusion Technology (running heart-lung machines at IOM MCVTC) and Anaesthesia / Renal Dialysis Technology (at NAMS, MBAHS and KAHS). MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BICTE (Bachelor of Information and Communication Technology Education)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream with required CGPA
routes.about: Tribhuvan University Faculty of Education semester degree combining software programming (C, Java, Python, web, networking, database) with education pedagogy. Graduates qualify directly for the TSC secondary computer teacher licence and IT developer roles.
routes.exam: TU Faculty of Education BICTE entrance test

routes.name: BE Agricultural Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or Agricultural / Civil Engineering diploma
routes.about: Taught at TU IOE Purwanchal Campus Dharan. Covers irrigation and drainage design, farm machinery, post-harvest food engineering, soil and water conservation and renewable bio-energy. Strong demand in irrigation projects, local governments and agri-mechanisation.
routes.exam: IOE entrance (Tribhuvan University)

routes.name: BE Chemical or BE Hydropower Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or relevant engineering diploma
routes.about: BE Chemical Engineering runs at IOE Pulchowk and KU Dhulikhel (cement, pharmaceuticals, food processing, green hydrogen and water treatment), while BE Hydropower Engineering runs at Mid-West, Pokhara and Purbanchal universities for tunnel, dam and powerhouse engineering.
routes.exam: IOE entrance, KUEE or university engineering entrance

routes.name: BMS (Bachelor of Mountaineering Studies / Adventure Tourism)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream, physical fitness and interview
routes.about: Unique degree offered by the government's Nepal Mountain Academy (NMA, affiliated to TU) combining practical rock, ice and high-altitude expedition field camps with mountain ecology, meteorology, rescue management and adventure tourism entrepreneurship.
routes.exam: CMAT / NMA entrance, physical test and interview

routes.name: BDes / BFD (Fashion Design, Interior Design or Multimedia)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream, creative aptitude test and interview
routes.about: Studio-based degrees in fashion and apparel design (Purbanchal University / Namuna and IEC), interior architecture, and multimedia/animation. Builds a commercial portfolio through runway shows, studio projects and industry internships.
routes.exam: University or college design aptitude test and portfolio interview

routes.name: BA Economics / Bachelor of Development Studies (BDevS / BDFin)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream
routes.about: Covers micro and macroeconomics, econometrics, public finance, trade, banking and project appraisal. Offered as BA Economics at TU campuses and as BDevS / Bachelor of Development Finance (BDFin) at Kathmandu University and Pokhara University.
routes.exam: Campus admission or KU / PU entrance test

routes.name: BA / BSc Psychology and Counselling
routes.entry: +2 in any stream
routes.about: Studies human behaviour, abnormal and developmental psychology, psychometrics and counselling skills. Taught at Tri-Chandra, Padma Kanya, Ratna Rajya, St. Xavier's and regional campuses, with growing demand in schools, hospitals, HR and mental health NGOs.
routes.exam: Campus admission or college entrance

routes.name: BSc Horticulture, Tea Technology or Fisheries (AFU / TU)
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology or Agriculture)
routes.about: Specialised commercial agriculture degrees: BSc Horticulture and Floriculture (Mahendra Ratna Ilam and AFU), BSc Tea Technology and Management (Mechi Multiple Campus Jhapa), and BSc Fisheries and Aquaculture (AFU Rampur).
routes.exam: TU IOST, IAAS or AFU entrance exam

routes.name: Cabin Crew, Aviation Hospitality and Airport Ground Handling
routes.entry: +2 in any stream, age 18+, medical fitness and strong English communication
routes.about: Short vocational training in aircraft safety, emergency evacuation, in-flight passenger service, ticketing (GDS Amadeus/Galileo) and airport ground handling. Many airlines also train selected +2 or bachelor graduates directly after open walk-in interviews.
routes.exam: Airline or academy interview, swimming/reach check and medical

routes.name: MDS (Master in Data Science) / MSc AI and Data Analytics
routes.entry: Bachelor in CSIT, BIT, BCA, BIM, BE, BMathSc, Statistics, Maths or Physics
routes.about: Interdisciplinary 60-credit master programme at TU School of Mathematical Sciences, KU, Pokhara University and MBUST covering statistical inference, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and big data systems.
routes.exam: TU IOST / SMS or university entrance and interview

routes.name: MSc Structural, Geotechnical, Hydropower or Urban Planning (IOE / KU)
routes.entry: BE Civil, B.Arch or relevant engineering bachelor plus NEC registration
routes.about: Postgraduate engineering specialisations at IOE Pulchowk, Paschimanchal, Purwanchal and KU in structural earthquake engineering, geotechnical and tunnel engineering, water resources/hydropower, transportation and urban planning.
routes.exam: IOE MSc entrance or KU postgraduate entrance

routes.name: MHM / MTTM (Master of Hospitality or Tourism Management)
routes.entry: Bachelor in Hospitality, Tourism, Management or any stream as per university rules
routes.about: Prepares hospitality executives, destination planners, tourism policy analysts and BHM/BTTM faculty. Taught at NATHM (TU), Central Department of Management, Pokhara University and Lumbini Buddhist University.
routes.exam: TU CMAT / NATHM or university entrance

routes.name: NRB, Public Banks (RBB, NBL, ADBL) and Public Enterprises (NEA, NTC, CAAN)
routes.entry: Bachelor or Master in Economics, Management, CA, IT, Engineering or Law (+2 for assistant levels)
routes.about: Officer and assistant posts at Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB), Rastriya Banijya Bank, Nepal Bank, Agricultural Development Bank, Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA), Nepal Telecom (NTC) and Civil Aviation Authority (CAAN). Written exams are conducted by the Public Service Commission.
routes.exam: PSC-conducted written examination, practical/IT test and interview

routes.name: Development Fellowships, UN Agencies and INGO Track
routes.entry: Bachelor or Master degree with community leadership, field readiness and English/Nepali communication
routes.about: Paid full-time fellowships and entry tracks such as Teach For Nepal, Daayitwa Public Policy Fellowship, UN Volunteers (UNV) and INGO trainee programmes in education, public health, governance, gender and climate adaptation.
routes.exam: Application essays, group assessment and multi-round interviews
